entities.summary: Caroline Nordengrip is a Swedish politician and former member of the Riksdag from 2018 to 2022 for the Sweden Democrats. She represents the constituency of Västra Götaland County. In 2023, she joined the Armed Forces of Ukraine as a soldier following the Russian invasion of Ukraine.
